kpis.name: Recoveries
kpis.description: Number of recoveries by the team per match.

kpis.name: Recovery line height (m)
kpis.description: Mean height on the pitch in meters of the team's recoveries per match.

kpis.name: Possessions retained after 5s
kpis.description: Number of possessions by the team that lasted longer than 5 seconds after a recovery per match.

kpis.name: Possessions retained after 5s %
kpis.description: Percentage of possessions by the team that lasted longer than 5 seconds after a recovery per match.

kpis.name: Possessions to final third within 10s after recovery
kpis.description: Number of possessions by the team with a final third entry within 10 seconds after a recovery from outside of the final third per match.
kpis.display_name: Possessions to final third within 10s after recovery

kpis.name: Possessions to box within 10s after recovery
kpis.description: Number of possessions by the team with a box entry within 10 seconds after a recovery from outside of the box per match.
kpis.display_name: Possessions to box within 10s after recovery

kpis.name: xG within 10s after recovery
kpis.description: Accumulated expected goals of the team within 10 seconds after a recovery per match.

kpis.name: xT within 10s after recovery
kpis.description: Accumulated position-based expected threat of the team within 10 seconds after a recovery per match.
